title: Aspiring filmmaker here. I have a question.

commenti.body:
My man, 

I think you just need to write something. These ideas range from well tilled ground to batshit insane, so just sit at that keyboard with confidence and see what you can come up with for a finished product.

2/10. Never go full retard. 

6/10. Very intrigued, but you’ll need a killer third act to not be repetitive. Just like Vivarium for example, I just got annoyed that there was no story progression and I’m noticing this a lot in modern horror/ A24 kinda stuff 


7/10. This sounds like such a convoluted concept that I have no idea how you could pull that off. Absolutely would have to watch it out of curiosity, very unique 

2/10. It’s too abstract man. I love the level of creativity but I would focus on structure if you have really out there concepts like this
